query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
age as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
village as "Village",
condition as "Ongoing condition",
to_char(((recorded_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Date recorded",
clinician as "Clinician",
to_char(date_resolved, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date resolved",
clinician_resolving as "Clinician confirming resolution"
from "reporting"."ds__ongoing_conditions"
where ((recorded_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
>= 
:fromDate
and
((recorded_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
<= 
:toDate
order by recorded_datetime
name: Ongoing conditions line list
notes: This report lists all patients with ongoing conditions for the selected parameters.
